solution:
"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/integer-break/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

343. Integer Break

Given an integer n, break it into the sum of k positive integers, where k >= 2, and maximize the product of those integers.

Return the maximum product you can get.

Example 1:

Input: n = 2
Output: 1
Explanation: 2 = 1 + 1, 1 × 1 = 1.

Example 2:

Input: n = 10
Output: 36
Explanation: 10 = 3 + 3 + 4, 3 × 3 × 4 = 36.

Constraints:

    2 <= n <= 58
"""


class Solution:
    def integerBreak(self, n: int) -> int:
        if n == 2:
            return 1
        if n == 3:
            return 2

        product = 1
        while n > 4:
            product *= 3
            n -= 3
        product *= n
        return product


sol = Solution()

print(sol.integerBreak(2))  # 1

assert sol.integerBreak(2) == 1
assert sol.integerBreak(10) == 36

assert sol.integerBreak(3) == 2
assert sol.integerBreak(4) == 4
assert sol.integerBreak(5) == 6
assert sol.integerBreak(6) == 9
assert sol.integerBreak(7) == 12
assert sol.integerBreak(58) == 1549681956
assert sol.integerBreak(15) == 243
assert sol.integerBreak(20) == 1458
assert sol.integerBreak(30) == 59049
assert sol.integerBreak(50) == 86093442
assert sol.integerBreak(8) == 18
assert sol.integerBreak(9) == 27
